problem:
Consider a vector space $V$ and vectors ${v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3},{v}_{4}\in V.$ Given that ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}}$ is a linearly independent set and 
${v}_{1}={v}_{2}+5{v}_{3}-{v}_{4},$ which of the following statements are true?

- ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3},{v}_{4}}$ is a linearly independent set
- ${x}_{1}{v}_{1}+{x}_{2}{v}_{2}+{x}_{3}{v}_{3}+{x}_{4}{v}_{4}=0$ has only zero solution ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}={x}_{4}=0$
- ${v}_{4}$ is a linear combination of ${v}_{1}$, ${v}_{2}$ and ${v}_{3}$

activity_context.topic_title: Linear Independence in Abstract Vector Spaces
